note: Re-probe every 90 days. 'Floor' = lowest credible price seen at a platform with seller accountability (warranty, return policy, or cycle-count disclosure).

fb_marketplace.weakness: no buyer protection, no warranty, no spec verification

kaidee.weakness: individual sellers mixed in, not all offer warranty

mac2hand.strength: Apple-specific, publishes battery cycles + AppleCare status
mac2hand.weakness: Apple only; prices reflect certified condition

biggo.strength: indexes other platforms, fast sanity check

back_market.weakness: USD pricing, shipping from US/EU; mostly newer models

dell_latitude_5490_i7_16gb_14in.notes: Popular used model; plenty of supply

dell_latitude_7420_gen11_i5_16gb_14in.notes: Premium ultralight, held value better than older Latitudes

dell_inspiron_5310_i5_11320h_16gb.notes: Newer model; Thai supply thin, Back Market shows what 'certified' costs

macbook_air_m1_2020_8gb_256gb.notes: Anything under ฿9k is activation-locked / battery-dead / stolen — verify serial on checkcoverage.apple.com before paying

thinkpad_x13_g1_ryzen_5_pro_4650u.notes: Ryzen 5 Pro 4650U ≈ i5-1135G7 in benchmarks, usually cheaper because AMD

hp_15s_i5_gen10_consumer.notes: Consumer-grade, faster price decay than business-class

fraud_detection_heuristic.delta_0_to_minus_15_pct: normal private-seller pricing — buy with inspection
fraud_detection_heuristic.delta_minus_15_to_40_pct: good deal, motivated seller — verify spec, meet in person
fraud_detection_heuristic.delta_minus_40_to_60_pct: red flag territory — demand serial, live demo, payment at pickup only
fraud_detection_heuristic.delta_greater_than_minus_60_pct: high fraud probability — assume activation-locked / swollen battery / nonfunctional
